transcription:
L1 | 1. Diketahui: Total seluruh siswa 36 ; Ditanya: Berapa jangkauan nilai siswa
L2 | Dijawab: Yang mendapat nilai 100 = 120 + 60 + 90 = 270 - 360 = 90
L3 | Mencari siswanya: 1. Nilai 100 = 90/360 x 36 = 9 ; 2. Nilai 80 = 120/360 x 36 = 12 ; 3. Nilai 70 = 90/360 x 36 = 9 ; 4. Nilai 90 = 60/360 x 36 = 6
L4 | Jangkauan: Nilai terbesar - Nilai terkecil = 100 - 70 = 30
reasoning: Computes the counts 9, 12, 9, 6 correctly but then takes the range of the scores (100 - 70) instead of the counts as asked (12 - 6 = 6).

transcription:
L1 | latihan soal dari colearn
L2 | umur ibu = x -> 29 . 3 = 87 (y x 3 = x)
L3 | umur anak = y
L4 | 5 x 2 = 10
L5 | 48 + 10 = 58 -> x + y = 58
L6 | 58 : 2 = 29
reasoning: Adds 5 years per person (the future offset) instead of 4 to the past sum, then divides by 2 instead of 4 (x = 3y), so 87 replaces 42 + 5 = 47.
Uses combinations of all 5 seats and adds them, instead of arranging the boys and girls within their fixed blocks (3! x 2! = 12).
Converts 10/8 = 1,25 and adds the whole 2 to get 3,25, matching the key; the chained '=' is loose notation.
The reflection of (-4, -7) over y = -2 to (-4, 3) is right, but a 90° CCW rotation of (-4, 3) gives (-3, -4), not (4, 3); the guessed P is never checked by working backwards to (3, 0).
Uses 4 even choices at each end and 9 for the middle digits, getting 104.976, matching the key.
